ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear LMPP audience recording captures a tight 1987‑style New Year’s Eve set highlighted by a seamless Uncle John’s Band → Ripple transition into Estimated Prophet and a powerful Touch of Grey opener.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the superb audience (LMPP) capture, calling it “rock‑solid” and far superior to many official releases. Musically the show is described as a tight, solid 1987 performance with smooth segues – especially the Uncle John’s Band → Ripple flow into Estimated Prophet – and a standout Touch of Grey opener that sets an energetic tone for the night.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (average 4.7★), praising both the recording quality and the musical performance; weighting gives a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: LMPP audience capture described as crisp, clear, and exceptionally balanced – no dropout or muffling noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a tight, well‑structured set with especially smooth segues (UJB → Estimated) and a strong pre‑drums segment that keeps the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drum section praised as solid; transition into the drum solo noted as smooth.
